parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const event = $json; const leadId = event.aggregate_type === 'message_draft' ? event.payload?.result?.lead_id : event.aggregate_id; return $env.SUPABASE_URL + '/rest/v1/leads?id=eq.' + leadId + '&select=id,organization_id,need,notes,contacts(full_name)'; })() }}

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $vars.AI_DRAFT_MODEL || $vars.AI_EXTRACTION_MODEL || 'qwen3.7-plus', temperature: 0.3, thinking: $env.AI_PROVIDER === 'deepseek' ? { type: 'disabled' } : undefined, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Write a concise Chinese sales follow-up draft using only the provided facts. Do not invent a sender name, claim a perfect fit, promise delivery, or imply the message was already sent. Do not use bracketed placeholders. End with one clear, low-pressure next step. Return only the customer-facing draft.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json) }] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const e = $('From Dispatcher').first().json; const ai = $json; const regenerate = e.event_type === 'command.regenerate_message_draft.succeeded'; return [{ json: { command_id: e.id, idempotency_key: (regenerate ? 'draft-update:' : 'draft-create:') + e.id, command_name: regenerate ? 'update_message_draft' : 'create_message_draft', organization_id: e.organization_id, actor_user_id: $env.SYSTEM_ACTOR_USER_ID, target_type: regenerate ? 'message_draft' : 'lead', target_id: e.aggregate_id, expected_version: regenerate ? e.payload?.result?.version : null, source: 'n8n', occurred_at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { content: ai.choices[0].message.content, ai_provider: $env.AI_PROVIDER || 'aliyun_bailian', ai_model: ai.model, prompt_version: 'customer-draft-2', input_tokens: ai.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0, output_tokens: ai.usage?.completion_tokens || 0, requires_approval: true } } }];
